description: One source-ordered s424 sweep over an aliased backing array with a 64-element feedback displacement.

pinned_source.attribution: The TSVC source comments attribute non-four-digit codelets to David Callahan, Jack Dongarra, and David Levine, Test Suite for Vectorizing Compilers.
pinned_source.license_note: No explicit license grant was found in the pinned TSVC files or repository material reviewed. These clean-room ports reuse no upstream code or comments and claim no upstream license or endorsement.

contract.operation: Set backing-array positions X[63] through X[n+62] to zero, then for ascending i=0..n-2 assign X[i+64]=X[i]+A[i]. Return the sum of X[63] through X[n+62].
contract.input_layout: [n, A[n], X_prefix[63]]; backing X indices 63 through n+62 are zero-initialized before the update sweep.
contract.arithmetic: Integer-valued source double/float additions; at most three additions feed any bounded output value, keeping all results exactly representable.
contract.success_result: Sum of the source-observed aliased view after the sweep.

output.meaning: Checksum of X[63] through X[n+62] after the in-place overlap sweep.

workspace.meaning: Temporary A[192] and backing X[255] signed 64-bit arrays.
